text.en:
Section 1 of Presidential Decree No. 1578 is hereby amended to include within its coverage the
following personnel of the National Museum, in addition to the personnel or positions specified in the
aforesaid section who are authorized to receive monthly incentive allowances:
Administrative Officer (Chief of Division)P1,000.00
Position above Range55 600.00
Position from R-51 to R-55500
Position form R-46 to R-50400
Position from R-41 to R-45300
Position from R-35 to R-40200
Emergency Employees100

The sum of fifty-four thousand four hundred pesos a month which shall be taken from any
savings of the National Museum for Calendar Year 1980 is hereby authorized to be paid for in the incentives
granted to the above additional personnel. Thereafter, the necessary amount shall be included in the General
Appropriation Act.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 2nd day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty.
